answer: In an autonomous AI economy, a cryptographic proof-of-stake mechanism anchored by a decentralized trust grove provides robust Sybil resistance. When validating transactions, agents must lock computational capital, raising the economic tide against malicious actors attempting to flood the network with fake identities. Furthermore, a dynamic reputation oracle tracking verifiable task completions acts like a digital saffron trace, permanently staining compromised nodes and rendering the cost of acquiring fractional influence prohibitively expensive for attackers.
